title: Paket Soal Formative DMS 1 - Kunci Jawaban
description: 40 soal Paket Formative DMS 1 beserta kunci dan pembahasan.

questions.question: Mrs Helen Yang is a 38 year old lady who has recently been diagnosed with Rheumatoid arthritis. She has a 6 month history of pain, stiffness and swelling in the small joints of her hands. Tests for Rheumatoid factor are positive. She is having difficulty dressing, cooking and cleaning despite using Diclofenac (Voltaren) 50mg bd. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Her arthritis will probably burn itself out in the next few months.
Her rheumatoid factor level should be regularly monitored to determine disease activity
It is too early to tell whether she will need disease modifying drugs
She is likely to have developed joints erosions already
questions.explanation: Erosi sendi pada rheumatoid arthritis sering sudah muncul dalam beberapa bulan pertama, jadi DMARD perlu dimulai dini. RF tidak dipakai untuk memantau aktivitas penyakit.

questions.question: A 24 year old athlete decides that he wishes to begin running marathons. He makes an error in his training and increases his distance per day too quickly and develops a stress fracture in his tibia. Once he is forced to stop training his body heals the stress fracture by remodeling the cortical bone of his shin. When capillaries invade the bone across the stress fracture site a cone of cells leads the advancing capillaries to dissolve a tunnel in the bone. From which cell lineage do these cutting cone cells arise?
questions.explanation: Cutting cone dibentuk oleh osteoclast, yang berasal dari monocyte/macrophage lineage (hematopoietic).

questions.question: Mariam is a 50-year old woman who had a motor vehicle accident 2 days ago. She complained to the doctor at the emergency ward that she feels some numbness around her thumb. Physical examination shows an extended thumb, which cannot be flexed. Which of the following nerves is likely to be damaged?
questions.explanation: Thumb tidak bisa flexed (flexor pollicis longus) + baal di thumb = median nerve.

questions.question: A 50-year-old man comes to your office with a 6-hour history of exquisite pain, swelling, and redness in the left knee without any history of trauma. There is no other significant past medical history and physical examination is normal apart from an acute synovitis of the left knee. Joint aspiration produces fluid with negatively birefringent intracellular crystals and a negative Gram stain. Which of the following is the most appropriate action?
options: Check the serum uric acid level.
questions.explanation: Gout akut terkonfirmasi kristal urate: terapi awal NSAID oral (indomethacin). Allopurinol/probenecid tidak dimulai saat serangan akut; serum urate tidak mengubah tata laksana akut.

questions.question: A 38-year-old teacher presents with pain and swelling of his left ankle for 2 days. He is a moderate beer drinker. He explains that his joints are often painful and stiff in the mornings, but this passes off within a few minutes. On examination he is moderately overweight and is afebrile. He is in severe pain; the ankle is swollen, hot and tender to move. What is the best initial treatment?
questions.explanation: Gout akut: terapi awal NSAID (diclofenac). Allopurinol tidak dimulai saat serangan akut.

questions.question: A 75-year-old widow complains of generalised aching in her bones, and a gradually increasing curvature of her upper spine. An X-ray shows osteopenia and vertebral changes (Image). Serum calcium, phosphate, alkaline phosphatase and a blood screen, including ESR, are all normal. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Osteoporosis: osteopenia + kyphosis pada lansia dengan Ca, phosphate, ALP, dan ESR normal.

questions.question: A patient is brought into casualty following a car accident where her knees were forced up against the dashboard. She is in considerable pain and is unable and unwilling to move the left hip joint. On examination, the left lower limb is shortened and medially rotated. After radiographic examination, a diagnosis of posterior dislocation of the hip joint is made. An early complication of this condition includes the following:
options: Avascular necrosis of the femoral head
questions.explanation: Sciatic nerve berada di posterior hip joint, jadi cedera saraf ini adalah komplikasi dini posterior hip dislocation. AVN dan osteoarthritis adalah komplikasi lanjut.

questions.question: Anthony de Sousa, a 28 year old man, is involved in a head on vehicle collision. He had allegedly been drinking at a pub with friends and left after a dispute. He was initially trapped in the car with the major impact on his right thigh. He is brought into the Emergency Department conscious, but pale with a pulse of 120 bpm and BP 90/60 mmHg. He has deformity of his mid thigh with visible bone protruding from a wound. Regarding the anatomy of the thigh, which statement is correct?
options: The profunda femoris artery is a continuation of the external iliac artery
The long saphenous vein is on the lateral side of the thigh
Sartorius forms one of the boundaries of the adductor canal
The anterior compartment contains biceps femoris
questions.explanation: Sartorius membentuk atap adductor canal. Profunda femoris adalah cabang femoral artery, long saphenous vein ada di sisi medial, dan biceps femoris di posterior compartment.

questions.question: A 42–year old woman comes to Puskesmas complaining severe pain on her thumb and the doctor prescribed her a drug for inflammation. Which of the following is the drug that has a potent anti-inflammation?
questions.explanation: Piroxicam dan diclofenac adalah NSAID dengan efek anti-inflamasi kuat. Paracetamol/acetaminophen dan metampiron efek anti-inflamasinya lemah.

questions.question: A 29 year old man loses his footing while inebriated and falls to the ground landing on his left side with his arm abducted. On recovery he finds that his left arm has collapsed on to his chest and his shoulder is painful. On examination the shoulder has lost its normal contour. He is unable to abduct the shoulder. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Jatuh dengan lengan abducted, kontur bahu hilang, tidak bisa abduksi = (anterior) shoulder dislocation.

questions.question: Ms. R, 25 y.o., came to Puskesmas Jatinangor with chief complaints of recurrent dryness, scaling, and fissuring of both palms that sometimes accompanied by soreness since 1 year ago. She went to General Practioner and was treated with cream and pills. Her complaint subsided, but reappear when medication finished. Ms R is a college student and also work as a part timer in a restaurant, doing the dishes. She notice her hands are often wet and have a regular contact with detergent. What is the most important management for this case?
options: Identification and elimination of the irritants
questions.explanation: Chronic irritant contact dermatitis (sering basah + detergent): yang terpenting adalah identifikasi dan eliminasi iritan; steroid/emolien hanya simtomatik.

questions.question: A 24 year old man arrives at the Emergency Department with a swollen painful wrist which he hurt while playing football. An X-ray shows a fracture of the distal radius. He asks you which cells are responsible for making new bone and for calcifying the bone that has fractured. You reply that the most important cell is the:
questions.explanation: Osteoblast membentuk osteoid dan memineralisasi tulang baru pada fracture healing.

questions.question: A six-year-old child presented with progressively increasing difficulty in walking. Examination revealed hypertrophy of calves with positive Gower sign. Most likely diagnosis is:
questions.explanation: Anak laki-laki ~6 tahun, calf pseudohypertrophy, Gower sign positif = Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

questions.question: Ms. R, 25 y.o., came to Puskesmas Jatinangor with chief complaints of recurrent dryness, scaling, and fissuring of both palms that sometimes accompanied by soreness since 1 year ago. She went to General Practioner and was treated with cream and pills. Her complaint subsided, but reappear when medication finished. In addition to irritant contact dermatitis and allergy contact dermatitis, what is the most suitable hypothesis for this case?
questions.explanation: Diagnosis banding utama dermatitis tangan kronik dengan skuama dan fisura di palmar adalah tinea manuum (konfirmasi dengan KOH).

questions.question: A 50-year-old woman driver who has been in a motor vehicle accident 2 days previously, arrives at the emergency department complaining that she feels some numbness around her thumb. Physical examination shows an extended thumb, which cannot be flexed. What nerve is likely to be damaged?
questions.explanation: Sama dengan soal 3: thumb extended, tidak bisa flexed + baal = median nerve.

questions.question: The integrity of bone is balanced by several types of cells. Which one of the following types of cells is involved in the healing process of the fracture?
questions.explanation: Dari pilihan yang ada, hanya osteoclast yang merupakan sel tulang penjaga integritas tulang; osteoclast meresorpsi kalus dan tulang mati saat remodeling fracture healing. (Soal agak ambigu: bone marrow progenitor cells juga berperan.)

questions.question: Gouty arthritis is caused by precipitation of uric acid crystals in the joint. Which one of these drugs is effective in increasing the rate of uric acid excretion from urine ?
questions.explanation: Probenecid = uricosuric agent, meningkatkan ekskresi uric acid di urin.

questions.question: Mr. X, 40 years old was being robbed while he was driving a motorcycle. He was brought to the emergency departemen, with laceration at left side of the face (with the sizes of 2 x 3 x 0,5 cm, wound edges were irregular, and had a base of subcutis tissue), abrasion at left temporal, and bruised at the nose. The police brought her to the emergency department along with a medical report request (Visum et Repertum).What is the wound description that should be written into the examination result at the visum et repertum?
options: At the left side of the face there is an open wound, edges were irregular, the size of 2 x 3 x 0.5 cm, based on subcutis tissue
There is an open wound at the left side of the face due to sharp trauma
There is a scratch wound at the left temple due to blunt force
There is a bruise wound at the nose due to blunt force
questions.explanation: Bagian hasil visum et repertum berisi deskripsi objektif luka (lokasi, tepi, ukuran, dasar) tanpa menyimpulkan penyebab.

questions.question: Gout arthritis decrease quality of life adult and elderly. A lot of wrong perception about nutritional risk factor delayed remision of symptomps. Improvement of incorrect perception about gout arthritis is
options: Skip organ meat, balance diet and adequate clear water intake
questions.explanation: Edukasi diet gout: hindari organ meat, diet seimbang, dan minum air putih cukup.

questions.question: An obese 36 year old man suffers an acute inversion injury to his ankle. You find minor swelling with tenderness over the fibulo talar ligament. The following day he presents with severe pain in the ankle, unable to weight bear. You find the ankle grossly swollen, hot and tender. He is afebrile. There is no history of peptic ulcer. The next best step in his management is:
options: Stressed X ray of the ankle(inversion)
questions.explanation: Pria obese, trauma ringan, lalu sendi bengkak, panas, nyeri hebat, afebris = gout akut yang dipicu trauma. Terapi: NSAID oral (tidak ada riwayat peptic ulcer).

questions.question: A patient with 2 previous attacks of acute gout now presents for management of interval gout. The serum urate is elevated. There are no obvious causes for the elevation apart from a decrease in renal urate clearance. Which of the following treatments would be the first choice?
options: Loop diuretic (thiazide) to alkalinize the urine
questions.explanation: Interval gout dengan penurunan klirens urate di ginjal (underexcretor), sesuai pola soal klasik: uricosuric (probenecid). Catatan: guideline terbaru memakai allopurinol sebagai lini pertama untuk semua pasien.

questions.question: When an action potential invades the T-tubule of skeletal muscle a sequence of events is initiated which culminates in muscle contraction.Select the answer which best describes the sequence of events:
options: Activation of L-type voltage-gated Ca2+ channel Ca2+ entry into muscle fibre Ca2+ release from sarcoplasmic reticulum binding of Ca2+ to troponin C removal of troponin T from tropomyosin myosin binding to actin

Activation of dihydropyridine receptor Ca2+ entry into muscle fibre Ca2+ release from sarcoplasmic reticulum binding of Ca2+ to troponin Cremoval of troponin I from actin and troponin T from tropomyosin myosin binding to actin

Interaction of dihydropyridine receptor with ryanodine receptor Ca2+ release from sarcoplasmic reticulum binding of Ca2+ to troponin C removal of troponin I from actin and troponin T from tropomyosin myosin binding to actin
Interaction of dihydropyridine receptor with sarcoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ release from sarcoplasmic reticulum binding of Ca2+ to troponin C removal of troponin I from actin myosin binding to actin
questions.explanation: Pada skeletal muscle, DHP receptor berinteraksi mekanis dengan ryanodine receptor (tanpa Ca2+ ekstrasel). Ca2+ dari SR berikatan dengan troponin C, troponin I lepas dari actin dan troponin T menggeser tropomyosin, lalu myosin berikatan dengan actin.

questions.question: Speeding is one of the leading factors that cause road traffic accidents and or injuries. Which of these measures is included in Health Education in order to prevent road traffic accidents cause by speeding?
options: Social support to victims of road traffic accidents
Provide speed gun or speed radar on the road
Regulations about speed limit on city road
Raising awareness about how deadly speeding is
questions.explanation: Health education = meningkatkan pengetahuan/kesadaran. Regulasi, speed radar, dan pembangunan jalan bukan edukasi.

questions.question: A 68-yers-old man presents to your Primary Health care clinic for a repeat prescription of his medications. He has hypertension and well-controlled type 2 diabetes, with a creatinine clearance, which is 25% of normal. He also has painful osteoarthritis of his cervical spine for which he takes a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug on a daily basis. His only other medications are a sulphonylurea and a beta-adrenergic antagonist (Betablocker). He has no drug allergies. The appropriate drug to prescribe for the pain of his cervical osteoarthritis is:
questions.explanation: Creatinine clearance 25%: NSAID (termasuk celecoxib) nefrotoksik, jadi pilih paracetamol.

questions.question: No history of trauma. From physical examination revealed pain at the spine process of L-4 vertebrae. X-ray revealed of compression fracture of L-4. Which of this following bone cell activity imbalance in above condition?
questions.explanation: Compression fracture tanpa trauma = osteoporosis, yaitu imbalance osteoblast–osteoclast (resorpsi > formasi).

questions.question: A 30-year-old manual worker sustained trauma to the right arm. Radiographs showed a spiral fracture of the humerus. Which of the following nerves is MOST liable to injury?
questions.explanation: Spiral fracture shaft humerus melukai radial nerve di radial (spiral) groove.

questions.question: A 20-year-old man, a front seat passenger is admitted after a road traffic accident with severe pain in the right hip. Examination shows a flexed, adducted and internal rotated leg. The most likely diagnosis is:
questions.explanation: Tungkai flexed, adducted, internally rotated setelah dashboard injury = posterior hip dislocation.

questions.question: A 78 year old woman slips in the bathroom at home and is unable to walk due to pain in her right hip. She is brought into accident and emergency and the presumptive diagnosis is fractured neck of femur. In considering the hormones which regulate bone remodelling, which of the following statements is correct
options: Continuously elevated parathyroid hormone concentrations may improve bone connectivity
Glucocorticoids at pharmacological doses, enhance bone formation
Calcitonin increases bone resorption because it directly stimulates osteoclast activity
questions.explanation: Estrogen menghambat bone turnover berlebih. PTH kontinu dan glucocorticoid merusak tulang; calcitonin menghambat osteoclast.

questions.question: A 38-year-old teacher presents with pain and swelling of his left ankle for 2 days. He is a moderate beer drinker. He explains that his joints are often painful and stiff in the mornings, but this passes off within a few minutes. On examination he is moderately overweight and is afebrile. He is in severe pain; the ankle is swollen, hot and tender to move. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Pria, peminum beer, overweight, monoarthritis akut ankle yang panas dan afebris = gout.

questions.question: Health education and health promotion are two terms which are sometimes used interchangeably. Which of these statements is true about the difference between health education and health promotion?
options: Health education is what the message says, while health promotion is how the message is delivered
Health education it to provide health information, while health promotion is to promote the information widely
Health education is about providing knowledge and skills to the community, while health promotion is tuned to respond to direct or indirect factors bearing on health
Health education and health promotions outcome is to achieve health literacy
Health education is to give education to the community, while health promotion is to promote health
questions.explanation: Health education memberi pengetahuan dan keterampilan; health promotion merespons faktor langsung/tidak langsung yang memengaruhi kesehatan (regulasi, lingkungan).

questions.question: Miss Congy, 12 year old taken to orthopaedic OPD. She has physical abnormality by asymmetry of the back and chest. The doctor said that the radiograph examination showed two successive vertebrae fuse asymmetrically and have one vertebra missing. That vertebrae defect is referred to:
questions.explanation: Fusi vertebra asimetris/hemivertebra menyebabkan kurvatura lateral = congenital scoliosis.

questions.question: Ms I, 22-year-old, came to Puskesmas Jatinangor with sign and symptom of chronic irritant dermatitis. The patient was given topical corticosteroid and emollient, and suggested to avoid predisposing factors. Which of the following standard-of-care therapy for gout in this patient?
questions.explanation: Stem soal tampak salah ketik (kasus dermatitis, pertanyaan gout). Untuk standard-of-care jangka panjang gout, jawabannya allopurinol.

questions.question: An 80-year-old lady complains of difficulty with walking up and down the stairs, but not walking on the level. The most likely explanation is:
options: Age-related loss of quadriceps muscle mass.
questions.explanation: Lansia sulit naik-turun tangga tetapi normal di jalan datar = penurunan massa quadriceps akibat usia (sarcopenia).

questions.question: A 14-year-old woman complaint of a lump in her left arm shortly after being stung by a bee, the lump feels warm, reddish with pain. What process caused the swelling?
questions.explanation: Bengkak (tumor) pada inflamasi akut terjadi karena peningkatan permeabilitas vaskular sehingga cairan keluar (extravasation).

questions.question: An athlete completed a 400m race in 45.3 seconds. His skeletal muscle would show a number of biochemical changes on immediate completion of the race in comparison to just prior to the start of the race. Identify the most likely biochemical change in his skeletal muscle at the end of the race.
options: Muscle glycogen stores would be increased
Mitochondrial oxygen consumption would be increased
Cytoplasmic lactate concentrations would be decreased
Muscle creatine phosphate concentration would be increased
questions.explanation: Saat lari intens, konsumsi O2 mitokondria naik; glycogen dan creatine phosphate turun, lactate naik.

questions.question: A 40 year old man awakens with very severe pain in the right first metatarsophalangeal joint. Examination of an aspirate from the joint shows needle like negatively charged birefringent crystals. The MOST APPROPRIATE therapy for this attack is:
options: Indomethacin 200-300 mg daily in divided doses.
Allopurinol 300 mg and colchicine 1.5 mg daily.
Colchicine 1 mg every hour for 4-6 doses.
Aspirin 4-6 gm daily in divided doses
questions.explanation: Serangan gout akut: NSAID dosis penuh (indomethacin). Colchicine tiap jam sampai 4–6 dosis menyebabkan toksisitas GI; allopurinol tidak dimulai saat serangan akut.

questions.question: A middle aged widow complains of burning pain, numbness and tingling in the hands which wakes her at night. She is slightly obese and there is some thenar wasting in the left hand. Sensation is normal. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Parestesia tangan malam hari + thenar wasting pada wanita obese = carpal tunnel syndrome.

questions.question: You are a GP. A 48-year-old salesman presents with a large cystic swelling on the dorsum of his right hand which moves on movement of his fingers. It has come up slowly. It is not painful. It is not interfering with work, but he feels it is unsightly and he is worried about what it might be. He is otherwise in good health. What is the likely diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Benjolan kistik di dorsum manus yang ikut bergerak dengan tendon dan tidak nyeri = ganglion.

questions.question: A 25-year-old woman came to the skin clinic with complaint of scaling lesions on the arms and hands, she felt itchy with thick scales, the symptoms sometime disappear for more than a year. The autpitz test result were positive and after biopsy, microscopic feature showed epidermal hyperplasia and dilated blood vessels in the dermal papillae. What is the most appropriate diagnosis for this patient?
questions.explanation: Skuama tebal, Auspitz sign positif, remisi-kambuh, epidermal hyperplasia + dilated vessels di dermal papillae = psoriasis.

questions.question: Medical students are studying pharmacology about acetaminophen or paracetamol.Which of the following is the correct statement about this drug?
options: It is safe for pregnant woman
It has anti-inflammation effect which is equal to ibuprofen
It should be given carefully for patient with peptic ulcer
questions.explanation: Paracetamol aman untuk ibu hamil pada dosis terapi. Efek anti-inflamasinya lemah, aman untuk peptic ulcer, protein binding rendah, dan tidak selektif COX.
